_comment: Adapter-specific declarations for the fleet tooling (Entwicklung/scripts). They live HERE so that a change in this adapter never touches the locked tooling. Readers: sync-iopackage-from-i18n.py (manifestI18n, release gate B03) and submit-stable.py (forumThread). Keys starting with an underscore are comments.

manifestI18n._comment: instanceObjects id -> key in admin/i18n/<lang>.json. Every manifest object needs a `name` entry (an object without one is a structural error, and so is an entry whose object no longer exists); `desc` only where the name does not already say it - an empty desc beats an invented sentence.
manifestI18n._note: The container object (info) has nothing to explain, hence no desc.

_listenPorts: Fleet standard since 2026-09-15 (Entwicklung/CLAUDE_PATTERNS.md, section listen-port declaration; enforced by the check listen-port-declaration): the primary port lives in native.port as a number, the listen address in native.bind — the pair the admin's port-conflict check reads. httpsPort is the optional second listener of this bridge. `ssdp` is a label, not a native key: the SSDP port 1900 (SSDP_PORT in src/discovery/ssdp-server.ts) is shared with every other UPnP adapter on the host by design and is therefore never native.port. httpsPort stays a text field with its own validator: ConfigPort reads native.port only, so a secondary listener cannot take part in the admin's conflict detection anyway.
